post.summary: Create or update products with stocks in bulk (JSON)
post.description: When product id is provided, that product is updated (must belong to the warehouse) and optional stock is added. When id is omitted, product is matched by name in the warehouse: if found, stock is added; if not, product and stock are created. Multiple items with the same name in the same request are treated as one product (no duplicates). warehouseId is optional; if omitted, the first warehouse for the company is used or a default is created.

warehouseId.description: Warehouse ID (optional). If not provided, first available warehouse is used or default is created.

id.description: Optional. When provided, the existing product with this id is updated (must belong to the warehouse). Use this to update selected products.

post.summary: Align (deduplicate) products by merging packaging variants
post.description: Receives a list of product IDs and merges variants of the same base product (e.g. "BISMARK da lt.10", "BISMARK da lt.5", "BISMARK da lt.1") into a single product. Stocks from duplicates are moved to the winner product with packaging info preserved in notes and packagingInfo fields. Product names are normalized to official fitosanitario denominations when available. Quantities in "pz" (pieces) are converted to real units based on packaging info in the name.

productIds.description: Array of product IDs to align

groupsMerged.description: Number of product groups that were merged
